QuestInfo.name: [Spiegelmann Express] All Aboard for Lonely Chu Chu Island!
QuestInfo.0:
#e#bSpiegelmann Express: The Chu Chu Truck Event#k#n

#b- Event Period#k
   January 18th, 2017 12:00 AM to February 8th, 2017 12:00 AM

#b - Event Details#k
    - Accepting the quest, #b[Spiegelmann Express]
　　 Depart for Lonely Chu Chu Island!#k
       will send you to the event waiting map.

    - You can start the event from #bSpiegelmann#k in the waiting map.
      (Daily limit of 10 entries)

    - Gather the right ingredients when a food order comes in.
      Receive #bFame#k and #bChu Chu Coins#k as rewards
      for completed orders.

    - #bChu Chu Coins#k can be exchanged for #bup to 50 million mesos daily,
      up to 100 New Years Coins daily, or a Food Truck Chair#k.
